thread_title: Rate limits in n8n HTTP Request node with retry logic
thread_context: I'm building a workflow that polls an external API every 5 minutes. After running for a few hours, I get 429 errors and the workflow crashes. I've tried adding Wait nodes between calls but it doesn't fully solve it. Any best practices for handling rate limits in production n8n workflows? My current setup: HTTP Request node -> Set node -> Postgres insert. About 100 calls per hour.
